raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (source_tz='UTC') stores txn_ts in UTC, while all other batches are America/Chicago local time (batch 14's 12:00 UTC start matches the ~06:00 local pattern). Those UTC timestamps are not converted, so the 18:00-24:00 local transactions from 2026-01-18 are shifted onto 2026-01-19 00:00-06:00, which inflates that day's volume distribution incorrectly.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH norm AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM norm;"}}
